comments.author: 66325452@N02
comments.text: If you have not read, then a book to put on your list... Paul Shepard's, The Tender Carnivore & the Sacred Game. I read it when I was about your age (only guessing) and never completely recovered. Thank god for that. Paul Shepard was a professor of Natural Philosophy and Human Ecology, a very  provocative thinker on the side of the high intelligence of hunter/gatherer man. The old hardback version which can still be found for sale online has some incredible drawings in it that the newer paperback version does not.

comments.author: 100330886@N04
comments.text: Thank you for the recommendation, I haven't heard of that book.    It sounds really interesting from the  synopsis and reviews on Amazon.  amzn.to/1Rrg1L4
